description: Convair T-29B navigation trainer c/n 240-329, ex USAF 51-7917 (delivered 18 August 1953), sold from Davis-Monthan to Frigoríficos Reyes as CP-1356 in 1977, stored at El Alto from 1981; trucked in sections to Cochabamba and opened in 2002 as the 'Biblioavión' children's library of the Red de Bibliotecas Simón I. Patiño, set in a small park. Open Tuesday-Saturday afternoons (Opinión, July 2019); mapped as a library on OpenStreetMap.
